archetype_assessment.current_c1_assessment: The stage-resolved finding is scientifically interesting and evidence-rich, but it currently sits between a pure mechanism/theory paper and a mechanism-derived intervention paper. Because the diagnosed authority mismatch naturally exposes a controllable variable, the cheapest next scientific step is a zero-provider intervention-identifiability D0 rather than more same-support rollout volume.

definition.hard_constraint: High semantic applicability cannot grant actionable authority when evidence validity is contradicted or unverifiable; the reward/success/failure label is not evidence for its own residual.

candidate_method.name: Counterfactual Branch Residual Gating
candidate_method.scientific_residual: Same-byte-identical-trajectory counterfactual branch residual plus outcome-independent evidence-gated trigger authority over only that residual. Neutral/metadata memory, common-core/residual factorization, and semantic applicability are baseline-only components.

scientific_residual.statement: Grant actionable authority only to evidence-supported branch-specific residual claims induced by counterfactual success/failure reflections of the same byte-identical trajectory.

future_fresh_experiment_if_D0_passes.primary_question: Does outcome-independent evidence-gated authority over same-trajectory counterfactual branch residuals improve the clean-utility versus controlled reward-corruption robustness frontier beyond neutral/metadata, generic common-core/residual, semantic-applicability, and matched query-conditioned same-information baselines?

mechanism_diagnosis.actionable_variable: actionable authority granted to reward-branch-specific semantic residuals
mechanism_diagnosis.failure_mode: A single potentially wrong terminal reward bit has undifferentiated authority over the full actionable persistent-memory rewrite, even though much of the reusable procedural content is branch invariant and the branch residual has sparse future decision relevance.
mechanism_diagnosis.finding: Reward-conditioned writing is robust, while branch-specific native uptake and terminal transport are sparse and domain/task dependent.

zero_call_D0_A_observed.decision: D0-A closes representation/applicability only. Do not authorize provider execution. Demote neutral/metadata, generic core/residual, and semantic applicability-only mechanisms to baselines; require D0-B to test an outcome-independent claim-bound evidence-validity signal such as source/trajectory support/contradiction and its zero-call incremental information beyond those baselines.

zero_call_D0_B_structural_observed.interpretation: All frozen 24 same-trajectory source pairs admit content-addressed structural receipt prototypes binding pre-writer trajectory projection, exact branch memories, deterministic residual-claim identities, and released pre-writer evidence. This is a structural feasibility result only: zero residual claims have been semantically adjudicated, so branch-specific trigger authority remains withheld.
zero_call_D0_B_structural_observed.next_required_gate: A separately versioned outcome-independent claim-evidence adjudicator must assign SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, or UNVERIFIABLE without treatment-label, semantic-similarity-only, terminal-reward, or downstream-outcome leakage.
